Positive TestRFC2661EveryEmittedMessageOpensWithMessageType checks all 11 control message body writers (SCCRQ, SCCRP, SCCCN, StopCCN, ICRQ, ICRP, ICCN, OCRQ, OCRP, CDN, HELLO), TestWriteICRPBody checks ICRP, and the .ci fixture independently reads offset 12 of a live UDP SCCRP and asserts attribute type 0. Verdict stands.
